bio: Just outside of the hustle and bustle of the city centre, you'll find this trendy spot with a wine bar on its lower level and a rustic bistro upstairs. The cooking has a Mediterranean heart, with croquetas and cavatelli likely to appear on a great value menu that’s perfect for sharing. The wine list plays a starring role, providing an extensive choice that largely focuses on natural and bio-dynamic wines from lesser-known producers – and the team have an excellent knowledge of their selection....
